title: UI shows blank data because fetch 500 is treated as success
symptoms: try/catch does not run on API 500
JSON parse may throw or yield unexpected shapes
Loading spinner stops but content empty
cause: fetch resolves on HTTP error statuses; only network failures reject the promise.
solution: Check response.ok/status before parsing; map errors to UI states; add integration tests for non-2xx.
workaround: Temporary console logging of response.status around client helpers.
